notes: Day 18 (Abba Theophilus, 23rd patriarch of Alexandria) opens here with the standard opener ፩ በስመ አብ ... አመ ፲ወ፰ ለጥቅምት; Amharic date ዐሥራ ስምንት agrees. DAY-BOUNDARY CONFLICT: verified p067-068 carry day-style numerals ፲፰/፲፱/፳ on "ወበዛቲ ዕለት" paragraphs, but the book's day openers (p064 day 16 ፲ወ፮, p065 day 17 ፲ወ፯, p069 day 18 ፲ወ፰) show those p067-068 commemorations are probably further commemorations of day 17 whose numerals were misread or misprinted; decide day boundaries from the openers, not numerals; re-check p067 header numerals. Ends at ¶፯ both columns with no arke on this page (arke expected on p070). Uncertain: Ge'ez ¶፪ years ፳ወ፰ተ (glyph looked like ፳ወ፫ተ; taken from Amharic ሃያ ስምንት); ¶፭ words printed ወተሐፅን በነቤሁ, እምንጊሢ, በቀዔተ (unclear, kept as read); ትንሣኤ normalised from glyph reading ትንግሔ; ወኵነኔ normalised from ነነኔ; ወተግሣጻተ from ወተግማጻተ-like glyphs; ፳ወ፫ቱ (pope 23) and ፯ቱ/፫፻፸ወ፪ቱ read with Amharic; Amharic ሥስተኛ kept as printed (not ሦስተኛ). Ge'ez ¶፯ words ለእመ ረከብኩ, እምኵስተርኩ, ወግረ, ወእምሐነፅኩ as printed/uncertain.
